assumptions: The R-169 v1.4, R-170, EXP-000790, R-418 and R-420 authorities listed above are the active owner boundaries.
The requested sign orientation is G_* minus E and the three tests must use one common regulated parent.
The fifteen R-420 contract fields are identity-locked for this revalidation; locking a field name does not invent an owner value.
A physical-empty branch requires a normalized state or configuration, measure or algebra, boundary preparation and a physical criterion beyond a one-point zero condition.
A finite preregistration audit may reject evaluation when any required owner field is absent; rejection is not a numerical sign or stability theorem.
Symmetry projection means removing the exact declared orbit tangent before forming a transverse Hessian infimum.

A physical volume, regulator or cutoff, boundary condition and explicit thermodynamic-then-continuum limit order.
Deterministic finite-parent maps for G_* and E, a full admissible tangent and an exact symmetry orbit tangent.
A transverse projector, regulated Hessian formula, stationarity residual budget and numerical or limit error budgets.
